error_handling.overview: Error scenarios and recovery procedures for Visual Debug mode. These cover common Playwright failures, environment issues, and debugging session problems.

scenario.name: playwright_not_installed
scenario.description: Playwright or browser binaries are not found in the environment

step.code: which playwright 2>/dev/null || npm list playwright 2>/dev/null || pip list 2>/dev/null | grep playwright
npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium
step.alternative: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium

scenario.name: navigation_failure
scenario.description: page.goto fails to load the target URL

cause.reason: Page takes longer than 30s to load networkidle
cause.fix: Reduce wait condition: use 'load' instead of 'networkidle'. Or increase timeout: page.goto(url, { timeout: 60000 }).

cause.reason: The server is not running or not accepting connections
cause.fix: Verify the server is running. If localhost, start the dev server first. Check for port mismatches.
Verify the URL is correct. If the site is behind a VPN or local proxy, ensure the network configuration allows access.
Capture the status code and body. The page may still be debugged for error page rendering. Use page.goto with failOnHttpStatus: false.

scenario.name: element_interaction_failure
scenario.description: Click, type, or other interactions fail

symptoms.symptom: "Target element is overlapped by another element"

cause.reason: The element exists in DOM but is hidden (display:none, opacity:0, off-screen)
cause.fix: Check computed style via page.evaluate. Use page.locator. waitFor() with state: 'visible'. If intentionally hidden, the interaction may need a different approach.

cause.reason: The element is animating or has pending transitions
cause.fix: Add a small delay before interaction. Wait for specific CSS properties to settle. Use page.waitForSelector with a stability check.

cause.reason: Another element (modal overlay, sticky header) covers the target
cause.fix: Screenshot to identify the overlapping element. Use page.evaluate to check z-index and position. Dismiss the overlay or scroll to bring target into clear view.

scenario.name: console_capture_failure
scenario.description: Console listeners are not capturing expected output

symptoms.symptom: Console array is empty but page clearly logs data
Console capture misses early page-load messages

cause.reason: Console listener was registered AFTER page navigation started
cause.fix: Register page.on('console') before calling page.goto. For SPA debugging, register before the SPA bootstraps.

cause.reason: Some cross-origin iframe console messages are not captured
cause.fix: Use page.on('console') with page.on('framegot') to capture iframe console output. Or navigate to the iframe's src directly.

scenario.name: screenshot_capture_failure
scenario.description: Screenshot capture fails or produces unexpected images

cause.reason: The page was closed before screenshot was taken
cause.fix: Ensure the page is still open. Check for accidental browser.close(). Re-navigate if needed.

cause.reason: Page rendered in headless mode with GPU issues
cause.fix: Launch with --headless=new (Chromium new headless mode). Or use headed mode. Ensure viewport is set.

cause.reason: Full-page screenshot fails on infinite-scroll pages
cause.fix: Use viewport screenshot instead of fullPage: true. Or scroll and stitch screenshots manually.

scenario.name: authentication_required
scenario.description: The target page requires login but no credentials are available

symptoms.symptom: Page shows login form instead of expected content

step.action: Check if credentials can be provided
step.code: Ask the user for credentials or session tokens.

step.action: If no credentials available, debug the public-facing parts
step.code: Debug the login page itself (is it rendering correctly?). Debug any pages that don't require authentication. Document the auth requirement for future sessions.

scenario.name: intermittent_bug
scenario.description: The bug does not reproduce consistently across runs

symptoms.symptom: First run shows the bug, second run does not
Bug appears only under specific conditions (time of day, network speed)

step.action: Run multiple times with clean state
step.code: Loop the navigation and capture 3-5 times, noting which runs show the bug.
Check for timing-dependent issues (race conditions). Check for A/B testing or feature flags. Check for caching differences.
Record environment details (viewport, user agent, cookies). Note that the bug is intermittent. Suggest adding logging to production to capture it.

scenario.name: visual_auditor_failure
scenario.description: The visual-auditor mode cannot verify screenshots (vision model unavailable, screenshot unreadable, or analysis inaccurate).

symptoms.symptom: Visual-auditor reports it cannot see the screenshot
Vision analysis is inaccurate or hallucinated

step.action: Verify screenshot file exists and is not corrupted
step.code: Check file size (non-zero). Try to open/view the screenshot.

step.action: Fall back to programmatic analysis in the gathering mode
step.code: Use pixel comparison tools (pixelmatch, resemble). Compare computed styles via page.evaluate. Use structural DOM comparison.

step.action: Document the vision limitation in evidence.md
step.code: Record that visual-auditor verification was unavailable and that programmatic evidence was used as a fallback.

protocol.name: session_resume
protocol.description: If a debugging session is interrupted (terminal closed, timeout), resume from the last known good state.

steps.step: 1. Check evidence/ directory for existing screenshots
2. Read evidence.md for the session state
5. Continue from the last completed step

protocol.name: clean_restart
protocol.description: If the session state is corrupted or unrecoverable, start fresh.

steps.step: 2. Clear evidence/ directory for the current session
3. Launch fresh browser with clean context
5. Begin from step 1 of the workflow

technique.name: api_only_verification
technique.description: When screenshots are impossible (headless CI, no display), use API-level verification instead.

steps.step: 1. Call endpoints with curl or httpie

technique.note: Screenshots are the gold standard. API dumps are acceptable only when screenshots are impossible.

technique.name: dom_snapshot
technique.description: When screenshot comparison is ambiguous, capture full DOM HTML for offline comparison.

steps.step: 3. Use diff tools to compare DOM structure
